title: Emergent Matter Research Framework (EMRF): Space-Entropy Compression Across 10 Relativistic and Cosmological Regimes
description: Open-source research framework, numerical simulation platform, and observational astrophysics testing suite investigating the Compressed Space-Time Matter Hypothesis (CSTMH). Implements multidimensional spatial coordinates X = {x, y, z, d0, d1, d2, ...}, thermodynamic entropy state coupling S(X,t), 1PN relativistic equations of motion, exact Kretschmann curvature calculations, Thiele-Innes sky-plane projection, SPARC rotation curve fitting, cosmological horizon acceleration evolution a_0(z) = c H(z) / (2 pi), late-time cosmic expansion solver (Pantheon+ & DESI 2024 BAO), and early-universe coupled relativistic acoustic oscillations (Planck 2018 PR3). Empirically confronted across 28,700+ observational constraints across 10 distinct regimes (Sgr A* 5-star cluster, Solar System Cassini screening, SPARC galaxies, SLACS strong lensing, Bullet Cluster, JWST high-z, GW170817 speed of gravity, Gaia DR3 wide binaries, Pantheon+ SNe, and Planck 2018 CMB acoustic peaks). Backed by 159 automated unit tests across 19 test suites.
